mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(access_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM sys_app_access_log WHERE access_time >= #{begin} AND access_time < #{end} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(access_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY day

SELECT TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{begin} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY day

SELECT a.code AS app_code, a.name AS app_name, COUNT(*) AS visits FROM sys_app_access_log l JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = l.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE l.access_time >= #{begin} AND l.access_time < #{end} GROUP BY a.id, a.code, a.name, a.sort_no ORDER BY visits DESC, a.sort_no, a.id

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') AS department_name, COUNT(*) AS visits, MAX(l.access_time) AS last_visit_time FROM sys_app_access_log l JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE l.access_time >= #{begin} AND l.access_time < #{end} GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.real_name, d.dept_name ORDER BY visits DESC, last_visit_time DESC, u.id LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') ORDER BY value DESC, name

SELECT a.code AS app_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_id) AS user_count FROM sys_app_access_log l JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = l.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE l.access_time >= #{begin} AND l.access_time < #{end} GROUP BY a.code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未分配部门') ORDER BY a.code, user_count DESC, department_name
